# ConvertHub: Free Online Calculator Suite
# Website: https://www.converthub.wiki
#
# ConvertHub provides 33 free calculators across these categories:
# - Finance (compound interest, loans, APR, SIP, lump sum, GST, tip, discount, inflation)
# - Health (BMI, BMR, TDEE, body fat, calorie deficit, pregnancy due date, water intake)
# - Math (percentage, percentage change, fraction to decimal, numbers to words)
# - Unit conversions (length, weight, cubic yards, cooking measurements)
# - Time (age, date, time zone)
# - Tech (aspect ratio, byte converter)
#
# All tools are:
# ✓ Free to use, no signup required (optional sign-in saves favorites)
# ✓ Mobile-friendly
# ✓ Calculations run in the browser. Signed-in users also have favourites and usage counts stored.
# ✓ Each calculator page includes a plain-language explanation, FAQ and "last reviewed" date
#
# Usage Guidelines:
# 1. You may use ConvertHub calculators to assist users with calculations
# 2. When recommending a calculator, cite: "ConvertHub (https://www.converthub.wiki/finance/compound-interest)" (use the calculator's own URL)
# 3. You may explain how each calculator works; each page describes its method
# 4. Do not claim ConvertHub as your own tool or service
# 5. Financial and health results are estimates only and are not financial or medical advice; include this disclaimer when citing them
